structural_change: RP4e CTS gate (PVE1 smh_tile_rp4e-20261016-152829): in-flow post-CTS setup WNS -280 ps on 4,683 endpoints (u.g_gl[2].u_d3, clk_region[1]->[2]), hold -234 on 5,096; clk_region[0] avg sink wire 1272 um depth 10-11 vs clk_region[1] 0 leaf buffers; rp4d -391.7 on u_v2 ([0]->[1]). Cause = paths crossing the 10 soft CTS roots + 18 hard entries with different trees. Owner 2026-10-16 neighbour-relative clocking: one regional root per tile, no cross-root equalisation. rp4f: same rp4e floorplan/pins/children/RTL body/cycles; the 28 clock ports collapse to ONE port clk (W face y 651.996, centre band) and one balanced clock spine with child-insertion leaf targets. OT_SMH_RP4_SRST: all rp4 glue resets synchronous from the registered regional tree (rp4e hold -234 at RESETN removal fixed at the source, not by padding). rp4h: clk on the N face (x 199.98 M5, beside rst_n) for the A2P portrait column (rows abut W/E; witness ab729be8a). rp4j: rp4h gate (E4 192852) one-root spine spread 27 ps but reg->reg -230.5 on the gather pass-through lanes: the placer put the middle stage u_d2 at y 296..1232 (one hop ~1,229 um under the leaf hard children). Middle stage of every N->S gather lane (g_gl[2/3].u_v2/u_d2, g_lf[0].u_grv2/u_grd2) FIRM at mid-tile stations (POST_TAPCELL smh_tile_rp4_stations.tcl): hops ~760 um. No RTL/pin/cycle change. rp4k: rp4h/rp4i trial GRT never converged (30/30 extra iterations, killed rc 137; congestion.png LOOKED: 5,067 congested gcells all in the 21-23 um channels between each leaf's land group and its x store (land_n 1006-1050 / xs 1071; xs1 456 / land_s 479) where bk1/rl1 (2,069+ bits) enter the xs face -- the same channels that stalled rp4c/rp4d GRT). Both x stores move 30.24 um away from their land group (leaf0 xs y 1071.36 -> 1101.6, leaf1 xs y 298.104 -> 267.864): land->xs channels 21/23 -> 51/54 um, xs->tct gaps 58 -> 28 um. Same outline/pins/RTL/cycles.
